# seanime-extensions

A personal collection of extensions for seanime (https://github.com/5rahim/seanime), a media server and client for anime & manga. All six are manga-focused. Author: Carlos Espinoza (https://github.com/Carloss616). Licensed under MIT. Repository: https://github.com/Carloss616/seanime-extensions.

## Overview

seanime supports third-party extensions: TypeScript bundles it fetches from a URL and runs in a sandboxed goja runtime (Go's JS engine — no Node, no browser). Each extension here is a `code.ts` entry plus a `manifest.json`. The build transpiles `code.ts` to a sibling `code.js` (the `payloadURI` target) with Bun, and regenerates a top-level `marketplace.json` that lets users install the whole set from the seanime UI. Both source and built payload are committed.

Extension types: `custom-source` (a metadata provider for the collection) and `plugin` (lifecycle hooks + UI via `$app`, `$ui`, `$anilist`, `$storage`).

## Extensions

1. Local Catalog (custom-source, v2.0.1)
   - Serves a manga catalog you curate yourself, for titles not on AniList / MangaUpdates.
   - Metadata only — does not serve chapter pages; you read with any installed manga-provider (matched by title).
   - Source of catalog data: a public/secret Gist raw URL, a public repo raw URL, a local HTTP server, or inline JSON. No auth header is sent, so private gists/repos are unsupported.
   - Entries use seanime's native AL_BaseManga shape. `id` + non-empty `title` required; the rest optional. v2 replaced the old flat shape (cover/banner/year/country).
   - Configurable in-memory cache TTL (Cache minutes).

2. Local Catalog Manager (plugin, v2.2.1)
   - Companion to Local Catalog: add/edit/delete entries from the tray or the 🗂️ manga-page button.
   - Tray UI: **list view** (sync controls, reading-progress section, searchable entry list) and **form view** (contextual cover+title header, reading-progress cards with seanime drift compare + Apply, full AL_BaseManga fields). Opening the tray on a local-catalog manga page auto-jumps into that entry's form.
   - Gist mode (GitHub PAT with `gist` scope): pushes catalog.json to a secret Gist the source reads; supports manual Pull and scheduled Auto-sync (interval configurable, default 30 min, uses the `cron` scope).
   - Local mode (no token): entries persist in plugin storage; user copies serialized JSON into the source's Inline catalog JSON field.
   - Reading-progress sync (Gist mode): captures chapter/status/score via onPre/PostUpdateEntry + onPre/PostUpdateEntryProgress hooks, pushes to progress.json in the same Gist, and restores on other devices via $anilist.updateEntry. Per-entry last-write-wins by updatedAt; orphan-progress cleanup button.
   - Permissions: storage, anilist, cron; networkAccess to api.github.com + gist.githubusercontent.com.

3. MangaUpdates (custom-source, v1.0.2)
   - Adds MangaUpdates as a search & details metadata source via the public MangaUpdates API. No API key required.
   - Methods: listManga → POST /v1/series/search; getMangaDetails → GET /v1/series/{id}; getManga (batch) → parallel GET. Anime methods stubbed (still reachable, so kept defined).
   - Not a reader — MangaUpdates tracks scanlation releases, not pages.
   - Maps the MU `record` onto AL_BaseManga (series_id→id, url→siteUrl, title, image→coverImage, genres, associated→synonyms, bayesian_rating×10→meanScore, year→startDate.year, type→format).

4. MangaUpdates Sync (plugin, v1.2.1)
   - Pushes reading state (progress, status, score) to MangaUpdates whenever seanime updates an entry — chapter "+1" bumps and manual edits.
   - Two hook pairs in init(): Pre hook stashes payload in $store, the matching Post hook pushes to MU only after AniList accepts the update (lock-step). Each callback is a self-contained module (goja serializes callbacks via .toString() into a fresh runtime, so helpers must be inlined).
   - Requests: POST /v1/lists/series/update (status + chapter; integer list_id), POST /v1/lists/series (add fallback), PUT /v1/series/{id}/rating (score; the list-update payload drops rating).
   - Resolves MU series_id by: (1) custom-source fast path — decoded from the synthetic mediaId of `mangaupdates` custom-source entries, no network; (2) explicit user link in $storage via the manga-page **🔓** button (relabeled **🔗** when linked); (3) opt-in title-search fallback (off by default, can mismatch).
   - Tray UI: **list view** (filterable LINKED entries, ⚙️ per row) and **detail view** per manga (AniList header with link badge, LINKED WITH MU row + Unlink, LINK TO / RELINK TO MU search). Page button + pinned tray auto-open detail for the current entry; auto-search only when unlinked.
   - Status map: CURRENT→0, PLANNING→1, COMPLETED→2, DROPPED→3, PAUSED→4, REPEATING→0. Score: AniList scoreRaw/10 clamped [0,10].
   - Config: username, password, autoSyncOnProgress, syncScore, autoMatchFallback, injectEntryIcon. Permissions: storage, anilist; networkAccess to api.mangaupdates.com.
   - Known limits: push-only; tray must be pinned for tray.open(); 412 five-second update delay not retried; credentials stored plaintext in $storage; no repeat-count sync; score-clearing not pushed.

5. Library Grid Layout (plugin, v1.1.2)
   - UI-only: sets cards-per-row of the manga & anime library grids, with a separate column count per screen size (Mobile/Tablet/Laptop/Desktop), edited live from a tray panel.
   - Reads the live viewport width and sets an inline grid-template-columns on the grid containers ([data-media-card-grid] and the virtualized [data-media-card-lazy-grid]); inline styles outrank Tailwind grid-cols-* classes. Re-applies on grid mount, new main tab, and resize across a tier.
   - Monotonic constraint (smaller screen ≤ bigger screen columns), values clamped 1–12, seanime-default toggle to restore the native grid. Permission: storage only; no network.

6. Manga Source Updates (plugin, v1.8.0)
   - UI-only: scans every CURRENT reading-list entry against all installed manga providers to find which sources have new chapters. Scanning itself makes NO external HTTP calls — reads chapters through seanime's own providers (ctx.manga.*); the only outbound network traffic is the opt-in cross-device sync (below).
   - Per manga probes each non-excluded provider fresh (emptyCache then getChapterContainer with AniList titles), in parallel batches (parallelBatch, default 10), classifies each source vs. reading progress (new / up-to-date / outdated / no-match / error), and summarizes the manga from its furthest-ahead source as "+N · M" (N unread on the best source, M = how many sources have unread chapters; shows "0 · 0" when nothing is new).
   - Auto-excludes bad sources (no match / fetch error / farBehindGap+ chapters behind, default 10); exclusions/pins/results/probes persisted in $storage and rehydrated after reload. Manual exclude/include pins the source so auto-exclude can't override it. TTL (ttlMinutes, default 60) skips a recently-scanned manga.
   - Per-manga ⚙️ detail view: Available / Excluded source groups (active providers only via getProviders(); disabled providers hidden but probe/exclusion data kept in $storage), per-source rescan, exclude-with-reason dropdown, include. Floating draggable webview panel shows live scan progress on every screen — a per-provider counter (bumped as each source resolves, not per batch) with a library/sources-aware label ("Scanning manga X/Y" vs "Checking sources X/Y"). Tray-icon badge counts manga with new chapters.
   - Injects results onto seanime's own pages (v1.1.0): a native ctx.action.newMangaPageButton "📚" on the manga entry, a "New on: {source} +N" bar in the chapter-list header, and a "+N · M" badge on library cards (the last two via ctx.dom). Reads progress straight from the DOM (src/_utils/dom-read.ts) so all surfaces update live on read with no gap. The DOM mechanics (signature loop/duplicate guard, per-target lock + dirty re-run, sync sig reads, denshi-safe query/append, restartable observers + re-arm lifecycle) live in the reusable src/_components/dom-decorator.ts harness.
   - Hooks seanime's OWN controls (v1.2.0, gated by syncNativeButtons, default on): the entry-page "Reload sources" confirm modal → scans that manga; the library "Refresh sources" menu → opens the plugin's own confirm view, then scans the whole list. These are radix portals at the document root, so they're observed with their own root-level dm.observe("[role='dialog']" / "[role='menu']"), gated by visible text (.UI-Modal__title / menuitem text) and guarded by a data-msu-*-hooked attribute (see hookReloadModal / hookRefreshMenu). Concurrency: any overlapping trigger is rejected with a toast; the tray "Scan" button routes through the same confirm view (a state-driven view-swap, not a controlled tray.modal).
   - Manual match (v1.4.0): watches the manual-match dialog; on save/remove mapping, scanOneProvider for the affected source then refreshes the chapter-list bar. Domain logic split into src/plugins/manga-source-updates/utils/* (classify, chapters, manual-match, providers, card-dom, etc.).
   - No-match vs error + panel controls (v1.5.0): seanime's getChapterContainer THROWS both for "no series matched" and a genuine fetch failure, which mislabeled most no-matches as "error"; readContainer now inspects the thrown message (isNoMatchError in utils/classify.ts) and returns [] for a no-match (→ "no match" pill) vs null for a real error (which it console.warns so the SPIKE regex can be widened). The floating scan panel is restyled with seanime's class-name vocabulary (UI-Modal__content / UI-Badge__root / UI-Button_root) backed by local CSS tokens (the webview iframe is sandboxed without seanime's Tailwind), gained a Cancel button (iframe→plugin via window.webview.send("panel-cancel") → cancelRequested, which the global + per-manga loops break on and scanOneProvider drops its result; the button sits in a bottom row + stops drag-start propagation so seanime's top drag handle doesn't eat the click) and shows the current manga's cover thumbnail; single-provider scans now also drive the panel (1-step progress). The panel's cover thumbnail is clickable (panel-open → navigate to the manga entry, or open the tray detail if already on it) and the "Cancelling…" state is mirrored into the panel (freezes the Cancel button). In the detail view, scan controls are disabled while ANY scan runs (incl. a global scan on another manga), and each source's rescan button shows a live ⏳ while that provider is in-flight in the active scan (scanningProviders state, keyed by mediaId). Clear-exclusions (global menu item AND a per-manga button in the detail, shown only when the manga has exclusions) now wipes exclusions AND pins for the scope, then re-discovers from 0 (global → force rescan; per-manga → probeMangaDetail) so auto-exclude re-runs cleanly instead of a stale pin suppressing it.
   - Timestamped storage + identity metadata (v1.6.0): all stored data (exclusions, pins, scan summaries, per-source probes, manual matches) now carries per-record updatedAt + soft-delete tombstones — the schema foundation for cross-device sync. Reads/writes route through a typed accessor layer (utils/store.ts: raw $storage access + live-tombstone views + probe-timestamp merge); no lazy migration (a one-shot migration was shipped then removed). Records manual-match metadata (utils/matches.ts: provider + mapped id, stamped with a per-install instance id from utils/instance.ts identifying the authoring machine, captured on match-panel load via resolveMatchAction, not only on change) and each custom-source entry's stable cross-instance identity (utils/sources.ts: manifest id + provider-local id, decoded from mediaId/siteUrl via _utils/custom-source-id's parseCustomSourceManifestId; captured in both the full scan and the per-manga detail scan). $storage keys renamed for consistency (exclusions/summaries/pins/probes/matches/sources/instanceId). All pure helpers have co-located tests.
   - Cross-device Gist sync (v1.7.0): all five maps (summaries, exclusions, pins, probes, matches) round-trip through one private Gist, one file per map (seanime-msu-summaries.json / -exclusions / -pins / -probes / -matches) so no single file grows huge; summaries is the head file (discovery anchor, listed first). Section/file names match the K_* $storage keys. utils/sync-keys.ts defines the wire-key contract: a native AniList mediaId pushes as its plain numeric string, while a custom-source mediaId (instance-local, embeds a random per-install extId) is translated to a stable `cs:<manifestId>:<localId>` key via _utils/custom-source-id + the manga's recorded utils/sources.ts ref, and translated back on pull by resolving manifestId→extId on the receiving instance (free from the local K_SOURCES index, or — for a manifest with zero local manga — a probeExtId $anilist.getManga probe seeded from the localId of the very key being localized, no separate remote pre-read, cached per sync run). utils/sync.ts (toWireMaps/localizeWireMaps/mergeLocalBack) does the local⇄wire translation; mergeMaps is a generic two-level/one-level per-record LWW merge keyed on effTs = max(updatedAt, deletedAt) (tombstone-aware: a delete newer than an edit wins, an edit newer than a tombstone resurrects; ties favor local). syncMsu (utils/sync.ts) is the round-trip fn: getGistFiles (one GET pulls every file) → merge with the local snapshot → push only the files whose canonical content changed (wireMapsToFiles emits canonical, key-sorted, nullish-stripped JSON per file so redundant pushes no-op; changed files go in one updateGistFiles PATCH) → localize the merged maps back into local mediaId-keyed maps for write-back. GistClient (promoted to src/_utils/gist/client.ts, shared with local-catalog-manager) does the HTTP; the gist itself is auto-discovered by the head filename (findGistByFilename) — no create/link/unlink UI, mirroring the "no manual conflict UI" LWW design. Auth is either a device-flow OAuth token or the githubPat config field (oauthToken wins if both are set). syncNow (register.ts) is called from the tray's "Sync now" button, silently on tray-open (10s-cooldown-gated), and — if autoSync is on — from a ctx.cron job every syncIntervalMinutes minutes (cron scope).
   - Live selective sync + per-device matches + polish (v1.8.0): the summaries map/file is renamed to `digest` everywhere (K_DIGEST $storage key, seanime-msu-digest.json gist file — now the alphabetically-first head/discovery file, replacing seanime-msu-summaries.json), and only the device-INVARIANT digest fields (title/cover/read) sync — derived counts (latest/sources/newSources/kind) are recomputed locally so a device with a different provider set no longer churns the gist; scan digests also split lastScannedAt (local, drives TTL, bumps every scan) from updatedAt (synced LWW clock, bumps only on real content change). Push is now SELECTIVE + live via a serialized coalescing queue (goja has no timers): manual edits (exclude/include/clear/match) push their own file the instant they happen; scans push at end or on cancel; tray/cron/connect do a full round-trip; pulls always merge every file. Manual matches are now per-INSTANCE (3-level mediaId→provider→instanceId→record) — each instance writes only its own leaf, so a removal on one device isn't resurrected by another re-observing its own still-present match; matchDivergence() surfaces disagreement (different series / removed here) as a warn pill in the source detail rows and a ⚠ on the chapter-list "New on" chips (the shared _components/entry-list gained an opinionated `warn` field). Provider probes this instance manually matched are kept local-only (omitted from push, re-injected on write-back) to stop latest/count ping-pong. Auth cleanup: real public GITHUB_CLIENT_ID lives in shared src/_utils/gist/constants.ts (one OAuth App reusable across plugins), and DeviceFlowClient was extracted to src/_utils/gist/device-flow.ts (requestDeviceCode + pollAccessToken + pollUntilToken loop + pure interpreters, mirroring GistClient) — per-plugin utils/auth.ts deleted; connectGitHub is now just UI/side-effects around the client, with a loading state. Self-heals a deleted gist (404 drops the cached id, re-provisions on retry); toasts on every real push with the maps uploaded, quiet on no-op pulls. dom-decorator's queued re-run now targets the LATEST (el, opts) via a Map (fixes flaky library-card badges when seanime's lazy grid remounts a card as a new element on scroll). "Force rescan" / "Clear exclusions" routed through the same confirm modal as the global scan (generalized confirmGlobalOpen → pendingConfirm + CONFIRM map). Single-source rescan (total ≤ 1) animates an indeterminate scan-panel bar instead of sitting frozen at 0%. entry-list sub-line badges/links now share a fixed-height inline-flex box + line-height:1 so tooltip-wrapped nodes stop drifting below bare items.
   - Config: ttlMinutes, farBehindGap, parallelBatch, syncNativeButtons, githubPat, autoSync, syncIntervalMinutes. Permissions: storage, anilist, cron; networkAccess scoped to api.github.com, github.com, gist.githubusercontent.com (sync only — scanning/DOM injection need none).
   - Known limits: scans CURRENT list only (other statuses probed on demand from a manga page); local-manga skipped; one scan at a time; float chapter numbers floor the unread gap; on-page UI depends on seanime's DOM markup (fails silently if it moves); sync has no manual conflict UI (timestamp LWW always decides; manual matches are surfaced-not-merged when devices diverge).

## Architecture

- Build: scripts/build.ts (Bun). For each src/*/*/code.ts it validates the sibling manifest (type whitelist; payloadURI must be the sibling code.js), bundles modules/*.ts standalone, re-emits each as a self-contained function, writes code.js, then regenerates marketplace.json. Never hand-edit marketplace.json.
- The modules/ convention: seanime runs each hook and the $ui.register callback in an isolated goja runtime (serialized via .toString()), so a callback cannot read module-scope variables — helpers must be inlined into the callback body. Put each isolated callback in modules/ (one export), shared helpers in utils/, import normally; the build inlines them. Custom-sources aren't serialized per-callback, so they can be a single code.ts.
- Shared code lives in src/_utils/ and src/_components/ (imported by relative path; the build follows the import graph). Notable: src/_utils/dom-read.ts (sync DOM attribute/progress reads for goja); src/_components/dom-decorator.ts (createDomDecorator) is the reusable harness for injecting UI onto seanime's own pages via ctx.dom — signature loop/duplicate guard, per-target lock + dirty re-run, sync sig reads, denshi-safe query/append, restartable observers + re-arm lifecycle; consumed by manga-source-updates. src/_utils/gist/client.ts (GistClient) is the shared GitHub Gist HTTP wrapper, promoted out of local-catalog-manager in Phase 2 so manga-source-updates' cross-device sync reuses the same client.
- types/ holds the partial .d.ts surface for the goja runtime (core, custom-source, plugin, mu-api).
- Tooling: Bun (bundle/test/tasks), TypeScript (typecheck), Biome (lint/format).

## Repository layout

src/<type>/<id>/{code.ts, code.js, manifest.json, assets/icon.png, modules/, utils/, README.md}
src/_utils/, src/_components/  — cross-extension shared code
types/  — goja runtime .d.ts
scripts/build.ts  — build + regen marketplace.json
marketplace.json  — generated index (never edit by hand)

## Commands

- bun run build — build every extension + regenerate marketplace.json
- bun run typecheck — tsc --noEmit over src/+types/ and scripts/
- bun run check — Biome lint + format (check:fix to autofix)
- bun run test — bun test (co-located src/**/*.test.ts)

## Install in seanime

- Marketplace: Settings → Extensions → set marketplace URL to https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Carloss616/seanime-extensions/main/marketplace.json
- Single extension: Add Extension → paste an extension's manifest.json raw URL
- Local: copy a manifest.json into $SEANIME_DATA_DIR/extensions/ and reload

## Roadmap

- Done: MangaUpdates source + sync; Local Catalog source + manager; cross-device catalog & progress sync via Gist; library grid control; cross-provider new-chapter detection (Manga Source Updates); list/detail tray UX for MangaUpdates Sync and Local Catalog Manager; cross-device Gist sync for Manga Source Updates (exclusions/pins/results/probes/matches, LWW merge, device-flow or PAT auth).
- Planned: anime support in Local Catalog (anime namespace reserved, not served yet); pull-diff UI for MangaUpdates Sync (currently push-only).
